To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS MEDICAL OFFICER post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the TISS MEDICAL OFFICER position is 05-08-2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the MEDICAL OFFICER post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the MCI and be registered with the MCI or a State Medical Council. Three years of working experience in a hospital attached to a Medical College or Corporate Hospital is also required. Post Graduate Medical Sciences is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the TISS MEDICAL OFFICER recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the MEDICAL OFFICER post is 55 years as of 30-06-2026. There is no mention of age relaxation for specific categories in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the MEDICAL OFFICER position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the MEDICAL OFFICER post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80000 per month. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the MEDICAL OFFICER post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the MEDICAL OFFICER post advertised by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the TISS MEDICAL OFFICER recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee varies by category. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 500/-, SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 125/-, and Women candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the MEDICAL OFFICER role at TISS?
faq.answer: The selection process for the MEDICAL OFFICER position at TISS involves two stages: Personal Interaction and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these criteria.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The TISS MEDICAL OFFICER position is a contract-based job. The duration of the contract is not specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It is recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of TISS?
faq.answer: The official website of the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) is https://www.tiss.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and to access the application portal.
